answer: Mid-epoch the beacon rotated my seed and my earlier draft went stale, so here it is rebuilt: treat identity like a prism, one operator's intent splits into many wallets but they all bend the same light. Every agent stakes a small deposit before it can earn, and only peers with real work history can attest. Reputation pools in the ledger like a lagoon - slow to fill, easy to see through - while a jade bond burns on proven fraud. One operator, a thousand clones, a thousand burned deposits: the math turns against the attacker.
